tenderSchedule.title: BTPS Unit-1,2&3 (2x500MW, 1x700MW) - Routine, Breakdown and annual overhauling I&C system Maintenance works of Out Laying Areas pertaining to AHP, RODM Plant, CPU regeneration, CAAQMS etc., for a period of ONE year
tenderSchedule.description: BTPS Unit-1,2&3 (2x500MW, 1x700MW) - Routine, Breakdown and annual overhauling I&C system Maintenance works of Out Laying Areas pertaining to AHP, RODM Plant, CPU regeneration, CAAQMS etc., for a period of ONE year
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer IOLA Office BTPS Bellary

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka.

A) PRICES: The agency shall quote on LUMPSUM basis (Total amount exclusive of GST) duly taking into consideration of carrying out maintenance works as per the scope of work, duties & responsibility and facilities to be provided as detailed in the tender document .B)PRICE BID EVALUATION: The L1 price bid will be evaluated and percentage variation shall be considered to derive the schedule-B item rates proportionately. Final derived schedule-B items rates shall be reference for payment.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall possess Independent PF Registration Certificate issued by the Regional PF commissioner and copy of the same shall be furnished.
Bidder shall possess Independent ESI Registration Certificate and copy of the same shall be furnished.
The bidder shall furnish registration of Establishment/firm/company/individual issued by Govt. competent authority.
Bidder shall possess GST Registration certificate and the copy of same shall be furnished.
Bidder shall furnish PAN card and Income tax returns filed for the last three financial years.

The declaration by the bidder that none of his contracts have been terminated/ foreclosed/blacklisted by KPCL or elsewhere on account of his default at the time bid submission shall be furnished as per the format in bid document.
The undertaking by the bidder shall be furnished as per the format in bid document.

technicalCriterionList.description: i.The Bidder should have executed the Maintenance works of Instrumentation & Control systems such as Boiler, Turbine, Generator, AHP, RODM and CHP etc., in 210 MW or above capacity thermal power plants. .ii.The Bidder should have satisfactorily executed the above said works in a single work order, as a Prime Contractor for an amount of not less than Rs 38.80 Lakhs (Exclusive GST) in any one year during preceding FIVE year (i.e.2021-22 to 2025-26). iii. Work done value of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which tenders are invited. iv. The intending bidder shall submit the single work order and relevant work done certificate as a documentary proof issued by the Competent Authority. On demand original shall be produced for verification.

i. The Bidder should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs.77.61 lakhs in any two of the preceding FIVE financial years (ie., 2021-22 to 2025-26). ii. The Bidder shall furnish the Profit and Loss statement duly certified by registered chartered accountant as a documentary proof. On demand original shall be produced for verification. iii. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited.
